correctness.rationale: The explicitly cited Kaneko–Stoll Theorem 2.2 gives ab<2^(-13+4*3*3)=2^23 for positive odd factor weights (3,3) and product weight 3. Therefore each factor and product is one of exactly 231 odd three-bit integers 1+2^i+2^j, 1<=i<j<=22. The package implements both complete factor-pair search under the strict product bound and independent product-divisor search. Fresh independent integer enumeration reproduced all six pairs, the 231 product candidates, and eleven ordered solutions, with direct bitcount checks. The external infinite bound, not the finite enumeration alone, proves exhaustion over all positive odd integers; it was verified against the cited theorem statement. No inference is made for negative/even factors or other weights.
